title: Documented Hardship Points on a Charged-Off Settlement Plan
content:
**Rule.** For a Charged-Off Settlement Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a request for medical hardship or death of a household earner with a medical bill or a death certificate recorded on it earns 10 points; a request for job loss or divorce or separation with a termination notice or a divorce decree recorded on it earns 5 points; any other request earns none. A document counts when it is recorded on the request as a document received. Each point is one percentage point off the settlement percentage.

## Document matrix

| Hardship reason | Medical bill or death certificate recorded | Termination notice or divorce decree recorded | Points |
|---|---|---|---|
| medical hardship / death of a household earner | yes | either | 10 |
| medical hardship / death of a household earner | no | either | none |
| job loss / divorce or separation | either | yes | 5 |
| job loss / divorce or separation | either | no | none |
| reduced income / other | either | either | none |
